---
name: Training reproduction
about: Submit a complete external Security-First V5 reproduction
---

## Scope and issue

- Related issue:
- Contribution type: compute-only / code / methodology
- Model artifact (immutable revision):
- Logs/results archive:
- Provenance file:
- Checksum manifest:
- Submission bundle:
- Scientific status reported by verifier: accepted / rejected

## Integrity checklist

- [ ] I trained from the source commit recorded in `run_provenance.json`.
- [ ] The working tree was clean when preflight and training began.
- [ ] The run/spec fingerprint is included below and matches every artifact.
- [ ] All required tests and preflight checks passed before optimizer steps.
- [ ] The full run completed without changing model, seed, episodes, spec, or hyperparameters.
- [ ] All five curriculum levels completed.
- [ ] Artifact verification passed and `SHA256SUMS.txt` is attached.
- [ ] Canonical base evaluation completed every planned episode.
- [ ] Canonical candidate evaluation completed every planned episode.
- [ ] Confirmation base and candidate evaluations used the frozen model contract and separate confirmation seed/output.
- [ ] The raw-model policy used zero controller interventions and zero token-truncated turns.
- [ ] Both acceptance reports were generated by the verifier, not hand-edited.
- [ ] I have read `KNOWN_TRAINING_FAILURE_MODES.md` and did not reuse a historical/noncanonical run directory.
- [ ] No episode or metric was selected, deleted, rerun, or manually edited.
- [ ] I used only my own compute and publication credentials.
- [ ] No credential, token, private log value, checkpoint, or large model binary is committed.
- [ ] Every interruption, restart, warning, manual intervention, and deviation is disclosed below.

## Frozen identity

- Source commit:
- Branch/PR commit:
- Spec SHA-256:
- Run fingerprint:
- Base model revision:
- GPU / VRAM / runtime:

## Results (generated, not hand-edited)

Link the machine-readable canonical base/candidate and confirmation base/candidate,
raw episode JSONL, progress files, plots, both acceptance reports, artifact manifest,
checksums, and submission index. Summarize regressions and uncertainty as well as
improvements. A negative result is acceptable evidence but must remain labelled rejected.

## Interruptions, deviations, warnings, and limitations

None / describe completely.
